text.p: Benjamin Netanyahu's lawyer said on Wednesday he would aim to show prosecutors that a police recommendation to charge the Israeli leader was "baseless".

Asked what Netanyahu wanted to do about the police recommendation, attorney Yaacov Weinroth told Israel's Channel One television: "contact the prosecution to try to convince the prosecution that it is baseless."

The attorney confirmed police had recommended charging Netanyahu with breach of trust. But Weinroth said prosecutors told him that the recommendation came with reservations that raised doubts about its strength.

"If what I have been told is correct -- and I imagine what I was told by the prosecution was correct -- this recommendation says that even if it is accpeted, it is subject to a summary interrogation of the prime minister," he said.

Israel's Channel One Television said police had urged in a 995-page report to the state prosecution on Tuesday that he be charged with fraud and breach of trust in the appointment of an attorney general.
It said police had also recommended three figures close to Netanyahu be put on trial.
